completed_items: Release auditor regression suite passed 8/8, including build-root discovery and POST /api/account/delete recognition regressions.
Immutable Drive source retrieved through GitHub OIDC/WIF and SHA-256 verified.
Exact source backend test suite passed 20/20 (one upstream deprecation warning).
Runtime OpenAPI audit inventoried 59 paths and 60 operations from the exact source.
Auth login, logout, current-user session, account deletion, reports/progress, and workout set/proof routes are present in the runtime OpenAPI contract.
Corrected a false ACCOUNT_DELETION_ROUTE_MISSING finding; the exact source exposes POST /api/account/delete.
Fail-closed evidence artifact uploaded and independently SHA-256 verified.

evidence.workflow_name: THF Fitness Backend Release Contract V1

blockers.detail: Exact source has no detected server-authoritative competition or anti-cheat contract/schema.
Exact source lacks acceptedSet, expectedSet, exercise_out_of_order and stale_set_sequence enforcement markers.
Health-related source markers exist, but runtime ingestion plus provenance/deduplication contracts are absent.
The runtime OpenAPI contract exposes reports/progress but no explicit authenticated sync route.
The runtime OpenAPI contract declares no security scheme and 0 of 25 mutation operations declare security.

The lane branch contains release tooling/evidence only; application source remains immutable Drive ZIP 1gcOkJ-EXnCEbCHMcBSUWAwVcQxj4j40- at SHA-256 2290c5897eab827dd778204de03f6f70c49fd162a32d187e4844172ececf7b74, so source gaps cannot be patched without a successor canonical source artifact and SHA.

next_action: Publish a successor canonical backend source ZIP with declared authenticated security, explicit data sync, runtime Health ingestion provenance/deduplication, and server-authoritative competition/set sequencing. Record its new SHA-256, rerun exact-source tests and both audits, then execute authenticated non-destructive production E2E for login, scoped workout write, second-client sync, logout/session revocation and account deletion.
no_progress_rule: If backend has no runnable gap, mark PASS with evidence rather than remaining READY.
